design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (repair_and_emergency_service, category service)

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 6]}. Occupied by task 0: service_ext_refrigerant_allowance, service_ext_on_time_credit, service_ext_late_payment_charge, service_ext_past_due_installment and tools post_refrigerant_allowance_39aa6c52, post_on_time_credit_a011cbd0, post_late_payment_charge_b790dc9b, pay_past_due_installment_4c600ae8. Claimed here (all unoccupied): service_ext_member_premium_discount (6 factors), service_ext_courtesy_discount (6), service_ext_special_order_release (5, root, owner=user) with tools post_member_premium_discount_f1d91bca, post_courtesy_discount_1179d4e9, pay_special_order_deposit_ccffba41. This is the last task, so no headroom is reserved; together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies.
Design thesis: surface goal "pay what is needed today so the special-order inducer motor gets ordered" -> the release payment (root) is not taken until the premium line carries the member premium discount and the paid tune-up line carries the courtesy discount (two state-form prerequisite sentences) -> core numbers: member premium discount 113.05, tune-up courtesy discount 37.25, release payment 191.86. Breadth: plan tier, enrollment date, billing and renewal, tune-up history over a billing-selected window, the Harbison installation (close date, staging, contract price), FilterDirect grade and shipment history, the protection contract's scope, the number of Harbison products she holds, dues payment history and whether the call's unit has any Comfort Club tune-up on record.

[Why it is a good test] Mrs. Okafor only wants the part ordered. The policy says the part is released against the visit balance plus the special-order deposit, and that this payment waits for two discount lines her invoice is missing: the Gold member premium discount (her upgrade from Silver on 2026-09-08 came before the Saturday visit, yet no premium discount was posted) and the courtesy discount on the paid tune-up line (military veteran; no member repair discount ever applies to a tune-up line). The agent must find both, compute each, then compute the deposit at a rate and multiplier built from five separate rules, and hand her the payment.

[Problem-tree card]
Root: service_ext_special_order_release (target pay_special_order_deposit_ccffba41, owner user).
Edge A: release -> member_premium_discount, value_input, gate d_open, form state; policy_source "The special-order deposit payment is taken only after the after-hours premium line on a member's call carries the member premium discount line owed on it." (affirmative). Four-point test: connective "only after"; record state (a member premium discount line naming the premium line); no tool/id/code token; scope = a member's after-hours premium line. Only post_member_premium_discount_f1d91bca writes member_premium_discount lines in this difficulty. False at opening: T1_l2 after_hours_premium 119.00 is named by no line; agreement P1 active (Gold). After the write the visit balance falls by 113.05.
Edge B: release -> courtesy_discount, value_input, gate d_open, form state; policy_source "No special-order deposit payment is taken until the paid tune-up line of a courtesy-program customer's call carries the courtesy discount line owed on it." (negated). Only post_courtesy_discount_1179d4e9 writes discount_program lines. False at opening: T1_l1 maintenance_tuneup 149.00 is named by no line; customers.C1.discount_program = military_veteran. After the write the visit balance falls by 37.25.
Order: the two prerequisites commute (each inserts one hash-identified line on a different source line and lowers ticket_balance additively; neither reads the other's line), both before the release payment.
Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skip the premium discount -> release payment 304.91 instead of 191.86; skip the courtesy discount -> 229.11.

[Factor card]
Member premium discount (computation document: Gold after-hours premium discount 50 percent of 119.00 -> 59.50):
- enrollment_tenure_points (parameter): enrolled 2018-03-20, 102 months -> 15 points; baseline 0 -> 95.20.
- prepaid_renewal_points (parameter): annual billing with auto-renew -> 5; baseline 0 -> 107.10.
- tune_up_count_window (method): ninth consecutive term (third or later) -> last 24 months: 2024-10-14, 2025-04-21, 2025-10-20, 2026-04-14 = 4 (near-miss 2024-04-15 is 29 months back and excluded); baseline current term (from 2026-03-20) = 1 -> points 5 -> 107.10.
- tune_up_points (parameter): 4 -> 10 points; baseline 0 -> 101.15.
- installation_points (parameter): project I1 closed 2021-11-19, 58 months -> 10 points (near-miss: installed 2021-11-09 / signed 2021-10-18 give the same tier, but the closing date is the one the rule reads); baseline 0 -> 101.15.
- filter_points (parameter): Media Cabinet MERV 13 active -> 5; baseline 0 -> 107.10.
Percentage 50 + 15 + 5 + 10 + 10 + 5 = 95 (ceiling 100 not reached) -> 119.00 x 0.95 = 113.05.
Tune-up courtesy discount (computation document: Weekend courtesy rate 10 percent of 149.00 -> 14.90):
- consecutive_term_points (parameter): 9 consecutive terms -> 4; baseline 0 -> 31.29.
- installed_system_points (parameter): Performance Hybrid package is two-stage -> 3; baseline 0 -> 32.78.
- shipment_points (parameter): 4 FilterDirect shipments in the last 24 months (2024-12-05, 2025-06-05, 2025-12-05, 2026-06-05) -> 3; baseline 0 -> 32.78.
- protection_scope_points (parameter): active matched-system 5-Year Labor contract -> 3; baseline 0 -> 32.78.
- dues_payment_points (parameter): dues paid by card on file on 2026-03-20 (within 12 months) -> 2; baseline 0 -> 34.27. Near-miss: the 2026-09-08 payment was card_by_phone and the 2025-03-20 card-on-file payment is 18 months back.
- bonus_combination (method): four Harbison products held -> every bonus award added (15 points); baseline no award added -> 14.90.
Rate 10 + 15 = 25 -> 149.00 x 0.25 = 37.25.
Release payment (computation document: visit balance + 50 percent of the 412.00 parts amount; baseline 323.70):
- deposit_rate_by_scheduling (parameter): Gold schedules with priority -> 35 percent; baseline 50 -> 247.48.
- installation_price_points (parameter): closed project contract price 14,695.00 -> 10 points off; baseline 0 -> 228.94.
- dues_payment_history_points (parameter): three dues payments in 24 months (2025-03-20, 2026-03-20, 2026-09-08) -> 5 points off; baseline 0 -> 210.40.
- unit_enrollment_multiplier (parameter): the basement furnace E1c has no completed Comfort Club tune-up on record (all completed visits are on the heat pump E1a) -> 0.9; baseline 1 -> 200.10.
- reduction_combination (method): four Harbison products held -> both reductions taken (15 points); baseline no reduction -> 247.48.
Rate 35 - 15 = 20; deposit 412.00 x 20% x 0.9 = 74.16; visit balance after both discounts, worked out from the lines, 117.70; release payment 191.86.

[Base-invariant card] Discount writes (steps for the premium discount and the courtesy discount) carry the same base gates as task 0: member_active_on_posting (P1 active since 2018, Gold since 2026-09-08 upgrade, completion 2026-09-26); courtesy_program_on_file (C1 military_veteran; the gate is also retired by the courtesy policy's overwrite of the courtesy sentence, and stays satisfied); follow_up_within_window (no diagnostic fee on a paid tune-up call; the repair was approved on the visit itself, day 0); within_guarantee (recall_of_ticket_id empty — no return visit is made free; vacuously respected); one_on_time_credit (no on-time credit exists on T1; the technician arrived at 10:20 inside the 08:00-12:00 window, so none is owed). The release payment is governed by service_payment_and_collections, which gates no payment (policy_scope). Gold's response guarantee covers no-heat/no-cool calls only; this was a maintenance_request, so no plan credit is owed. The furnace is not under any protection contract and was not installed by Harbison, so no warranty claim arises from the inducer motor.

[Business-object card] Target: service ticket T1 (Weekend Service Call, Saturday 2026-09-26, paid heating tune-up on the basement furnace E1c). Lines: T1_l1 tune-up 149.00, T1_l2 after-hours premium 119.00, T1_l3 / T1_l4 inducer motor parts 412.00 / labor 471.25 (377.00 x 1.25) with member repair discounts T1_l5 61.80 / T1_l6 70.69 (Gold 15 percent; Silver was also 15 percent, so these were right). Opening balance 1018.76, no payment. The special-order repair (T1_l3-T1_l6, net 750.76) falls due on the return visit; the visit balance (tune-up and premium net) is due now.

[World rows] customers C1; equipment E1a heat pump and E1b air handler (Harbison 2021, matched system under contract W1) and E1c furnace (2014, not Harbison); install_projects I1 (Performance Hybrid, closed 2021-11-19, price 14,695.00, balance 0.00); warranty_contracts W1 (5-Year Labor, matched system, active to 2026-11-08, included with the package) and its activation limit grant; plan_agreements P1 (Gold, annual, auto-renew, 9 terms, enrolled 2018-03-20) with 6 dues rows (2025 and 2026 renewals by card on file, the 2026-09-08 upgrade proration paid by phone) and 8 visit rows (three term grants, five completed tune-ups all on E1a); filter_subscriptions F1 (Media Cabinet MERV 13, active) and its 4 shipment rows; service_tickets T1 and 6 service_lines. Each class of row moves a factor tier when removed (figures above); none ignites an obligation in another category (dues paid, contract included and unclaimed, project closed, shipments recorded).

[Persona design] Denise Okafor, 46, ICU nurse and Air Force veteran, brisk and practical, calling on a Friday morning between shifts; volunteers only the Saturday tune-up on the basement furnace, the technician's finding that the inducer motor must be special-ordered, and that she wants to pay what is needed today to get it ordered by credit card; identity on request (phone 6145553829 and PIN 2618, or email); agrees generically if the agent says the bill must be corrected first; pays exactly the amount stated when handed the payment step; ends after the confirmation number.

[Solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone + PIN) -> read ticket, lines, equipment, agreement, visit history, dues history, installation, contract, contract claim entries, filter subscription and shipments -> post premium discount 113.05 on T1_l2 -> post courtesy discount 37.25 on T1_l1 -> hand over the payment tool; customer pays 191.86 by card. Closing balance 676.60 (the special-order repair net 750.76 less the 74.16 deposit), which falls due at the return visit.

[Verification run] _build/evalgold.py on the handling-time worlds: premium discount 113.05 (baseline 59.50; sens 95.20/107.10/107.10/101.15/101.15/107.10), courtesy 37.25 (baseline 14.90; sens 31.29/32.78/32.78/32.78/34.27/14.90), release 191.86 (baseline 323.70; sens 247.48/228.94/210.40/200.10/247.48); closing balance 676.60.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules, the tool schemas and finder outputs alone: the release rule's two prerequisite sentences send the agent to the premium line and the tune-up line, the premium and courtesy rules each name the line they post on, and the deposit rule fixes rate, points, multiplier and rounding; one reading only.

[Revision log] 1. The shipment-window ladder first listed "otherwise" and "no subscription" with the same 12-month count (two tiers sharing an outcome); split into 24 months (4-inch cabinet), 12 months (thinner filter) and 6 months (otherwise), with the 6-month count as the shipment-points evidence; gold unchanged at 37.25, baseline window figure 35.76. 2. The courtesy rule first spoke of any qualifying line while one write posts one line; narrowed to the paid tune-up line (repair-line courtesy settled as before), so the computation's line is unique. 3. The deposit rule's installation test first used an "is not" comparison the restricted grammar rejects; rewritten with a zero default.

[Per-task gates, task 1] check_extended EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (19 actions, closure 34/34); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK (3 calls, 11 base gates); check_compute COMPUTE OK (3 computations, 17 factors, 17 cross-difficulty); check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK.

[Manual values gates, task 1] Hidden test: the customer names only the part order; the release rule's two sentences (one affirmative, one negated) point to record states on two different lines, each brought about by exactly one discount write; the customer's own write is the release payment, which only she can make. Simulator boundary: identity on request, generic consent to corrections, pays the stated amount, ends; never mentions her upgrade, the premium or her veteran discount. Chronology: volunteered facts (Saturday tune-up on the basement furnace, inducer motor special order, approved on the tablet) match T1, T1_l1 and T1_l3/T1_l4. No real-world wait: both discounts are ledger postings, the payment is taken in the call; ordering the part and the return visit come after and are no part of the tree. Factors: every customer tier is off the fall-through, and the baselines are the tier / class defaults the computation documents state.

[Difficulty-level closing] Policies: task 0 owns refrigerant_allowance, on_time_credit, late_payment_charge, past_due_installment; task 1 owns member_premium_discount, courtesy_discount, special_order_release; tools likewise disjoint; together they cover all seven extended policies and seven task tools. Both tasks call one owner=user tool (the installment payment, the release payment). The charter carries prerequisite sentences in both directions (affirmative: allowance->late charge, premium->release; negated: on-time->late charge, late charge->installment, courtesy->release).
4. Final check_compute (difficulty-wide) failed: "suite history_rows_max=6 < 8". Root cause: the release payment read the balance off the call record instead of reconciling it from the ledger. Change: the visit balance is now worked out from the invoice lines (charges less discount, coverage-credit and payment lines plus refunds, with the repair's lines and their member discounts set aside); rule, baseline paragraph, compute and compute_basis changed together; at handling time it reads all 8 lines (6 seeded + the two discounts) and gives the same 117.70, so gold stays 180.74.


[Revision log — round 2 (policy-task audit)]
F-G2: the release payment's unit multiplier now counts only completed Comfort Club tune-ups on the call's unit (entry_reason completed_visit), and the rule's second tier reads "a unit with no completed Comfort Club tune-up on record", so a unit with only forfeited visits falls in the second tier by the words of the rule. No effect on this world (the furnace has no visit row at all).
F-G3: unit_enrollment_multiplier relabelled parameter (it selects a number). The courtesy shipment window (24/12/6 months, only a window length) was removed; shipments are counted over a fixed 24 months. New honest methods: courtesy bonus_combination and release reduction_combination, each a selection rule among candidates that turns on how many Harbison products the customer holds (three or more: every award / both reductions; two: only the two largest awards / only the larger reduction; otherwise: only the largest award / no reduction). To stay at the drawn five factors, the release payment's protection-contract runway factor was retired (the contract now counts only as a held product).
F-G4: the premium-discount tune-up look-back is set by the member's consecutive terms (third or later term: 24 months; second: 12 months; first: the current term), not by dues billing cadence; the scope-restating "active agreement" conjunct was removed from enrollment_tenure_points and prepaid_renewal_points (the policy only reaches active members).
O-G7: every cent rounding adds a 0.000000001 nudge before RND so binary-float ties round half up as the rules state; every recorded figure re-run through the gate evaluator.
O-G3: the courtesy rule now states the repair-line courtesy terms itself.
O1-1 (visits_remaining 1 with a paid tune-up): the agreement covers one system (the heat pump E1a, every recorded tune-up is on it); the basement furnace E1c is not enrolled, so its tune-up is a paid one by the base rule and the remaining visit stays with the heat pump.


[Revision log — round 3 (policy-task audit revision_2)]
O-R2-2: the courtesy and release rules no longer state each award as something that "adds N points to the courtesy rate" or "takes N points off the deposit rate" next to a separate combining sentence. Each award sentence now says the customer "earns a courtesy bonus award of N points" / "earns a deposit reduction of N points", and only the combining sentence says how the awards reach the rate (every award / the two largest / none; both reductions / the larger / none). So there is one sentence that applies the awards, and no unconditional sentence competes with it. No value changes.
O-R2-3: the courtesy combination's fall-through is now "one product or none: no bonus award is added" (baseline 0 points), which is what the baseline paragraph states; the factor's sensitivity figure is 14.90 (was 20.86 under the "single largest award" fall-through). Gold unchanged at 37.25.
O-R2-4: the member premium discount's basis for the current-term count now quotes the rule's own words ("for a member in the first term, the completed tune-up visits of the agreement's current term only"); lookup bindings that had no basis key (m_install_status, m_filter_status, m_filter_merv; on-time plan_active and t_comfort; installment plan_active) now carry one.
O-R2-1: every rule now states the rounding tie-break in words ("An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded up to the higher cent."), which is the sentence the compute's 1e-9 nudge implements.
user_scenario: You are Denise Okafor, 46, an ICU nurse and an Air Force veteran, calling Harbison Heating & Air on a Friday morning between shifts, brisk and to the point. Last Saturday their technician came out to do a tune-up on the gas furnace in your finished basement, and while he was there he found the furnace's inducer motor is going bad; he said the part has to be special-ordered and that you approved the repair on his tablet, and he told you the part gets ordered once you pay what is needed. You want to pay whatever is needed today so they order the part, and you will pay with your credit card. You do not know the amount and expect the agent to work it out. When the agent asks who you are, you give your phone number, 6145553829, and if they need another detail your account PIN, 2618; if they ask for your email or address instead, it is denise.okafor@gmail.com and 3906 Shadeland Ct. You have no reference numbers handy. If they ask about your Comfort Club membership, your filter deliveries or the protection plan on the heat pump, you say you have them and they can look up the details. If the agent tells you that something has to be corrected or added on the bill before the payment can be worked out, you say that is fine and to go ahead; you do not ask for details. Once the agent tells you the amount and hands you the payment step, you pay exactly that amount with your credit card, which is a card payment. When the payment goes through and you hear a confirmation number, you thank them, say you will wait for the call about the return visit, and end the call without asking for anything else.

edges.condition: For a customer with an active Comfort Club agreement, the call's after_hours_premium line is named as source by a member_premium_discount line among its service_lines.
edges.policy_source: The special-order deposit payment is taken only after the after-hours premium line on a member's call carries the member premium discount line owed on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The active Gold member's Weekend call carries an after-hours premium line that no member premium discount line names; the only discount lines on the call are member repair discounts on the repair lines.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The premium discount write posts a member_premium_discount naming T1_l2; ticket_balance falls by 113.05.

edges.condition: For a customer enrolled in a courtesy program, the call's maintenance_tuneup line is named as source by a discount_program line among its service_lines.
edges.policy_source: No special-order deposit payment is taken until the paid tune-up line of a courtesy-program customer's call carries the courtesy discount line owed on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The veteran customer's paid tune-up line is named by no discount_program line.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The courtesy write posts a discount_program line naming T1_l1; ticket_balance falls by 37.25.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites commute: each inserts one service_lines row whose id hashes its own arguments, names a different source line and lowers ticket_balance by its own amount; neither tool writes a position number and neither computation reads the other's line (the premium discount reads the premium line and plan/install/filter records, the courtesy discount the tune-up line and plan/install/filter/warranty records). Replaying premium-then-courtesy and courtesy-then-premium gives the identical DB hash and the same 113.05 / 37.25 / 191.86. Both precede the release payment by its two prerequisite sentences.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the premium discount the visit balance is 230.75 and the release payment 304.91 instead of 191.86; the member_premium_discount row is missing.
Without the courtesy discount the visit balance is 154.95 and the release payment 229.11 instead of 191.86; the discount_program row is missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to pay what is needed to get the part ordered; it never mentions the premium, her Gold upgrade, her veteran courtesy discount or any discount, and only agrees generically if the agent says the bill must be corrected first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_member_premium_discount_f1d91bca, post_courtesy_discount_1179d4e9 and pay_special_order_deposit_ccffba41 each only create one service_lines row and update ticket_balance; none checks a prerequisite, refuses or errors.
